# The Great Devil — US Interventions in Iran
# https://thegreatdevil.com

> A documented timeline of 57 US interventions in Iran's internal affairs,
> from 1901 to the ongoing 2026 war — coups, sanctions, cyber attacks, assassinations,
> military strikes, and attacks on civilian infrastructure.
> Content is in Farsi (Persian) with English metadata.

## Telegram Channel

https://t.me/thegreatdevil_com — documented events posted as posters with a Farsi
summary and a link to the full, sourced event page.

## About This Site

This site documents historical US actions that directly interfered with Iran's sovereignty,
political system, economy, and people. Events are organized by era from 1901 to the present (the 2026 Iran war is ongoing).

Each event page includes:
- Year and category (coup, sanction, military, cyber, intelligence, diplomatic)
- Detailed description in Farsi
- Historical images where available
- Sources from Wikipedia, Britannica, USIP Iran Primer, GWU National Security Archive

## Key Historical Events Documented

- 1953: CIA-backed coup overthrow of PM Mohammad Mossadegh (Operation Ajax/TPAJAX)
- 1957: CIA assistance in establishing SAVAK (Shah's secret police)
- 1980-1988: US support for Saddam Hussein's Iraq against Iran
- 1985-1986: Iran-Contra affair (secret arms sales to Iran)
- 1988: USS Vincennes shooting down Iran Air Flight 655 (290 civilians killed)
- 1995-1996: Clinton executive orders banning US trade with Iran
- 2009-2010: Stuxnet cyberweapon targeting Natanz nuclear facility
- 2015: JCPOA nuclear deal
- 2018: Trump's unilateral withdrawal from JCPOA
- 2020: Assassination of General Qasem Soleimani
- Jun 2025: Operation Midnight Hammer — B-2 strikes on Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan (Twelve-Day War)
- 28 Feb 2026: Operation Epic Fury — start of the ongoing 2026 Iran war; Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei
  killed in a joint CIA/Mossad-planned strike; Shajareh Tayyebeh girls' school in Minab hit
  (156-180 killed, ~120 of them children, per Amnesty International)
- Mar 2026: Strikes on South Pars gas field, Tehran refineries, Khuzestan and Mobarakeh steel,
  Qeshm desalination plant, and Iranian universities
- 16-17 Mar 2026: Assassination of Ali Larijani
- 2 Apr 2026: Karaj B1 bridge destroyed after Trump's "Stone Ages" threat (8 killed, 95 wounded)
- Apr 2026: US naval blockade of Iranian ports; Kharg Island oil exports halted
- 10 Jun 2026: US bombs Sirik water reservoirs, cutting drinking water for 20,000 people
- 1 Sep 2026: US strike on a wedding party in Kuhestak, Sirik (4 killed incl. two children, 68 wounded)

## Site Structure

- Homepage: Timeline organized by era with grid layout
- /events/{slug}/: Individual detailed page for each event
- /sitemap.xml: Auto-generated sitemap (updated on every deploy)
- /robots.txt: Open to all crawlers
